description: REIT income-statement skeleton for SIC 6798 retaining all 181 supplied unique US GAAP concepts once. The supplied Realty Income reference guides broad presentation; property-owning and mortgage-investment activities, overlapping measurements and result attribution remain distinct. Hierarchy prescribes no arithmetic or individual-issuer completeness.
classification_notes: All 181 supplied unique concepts appear once. The SIC inventory includes property-owning and mortgage-investment REITs; it is not a claim that Realty Income reports every concept.

The reference presentation guides families and ordering only. Its banks interest caption, unusual-items aggregation, EBIT and EBITDA do not establish taxonomy equivalence or reported calculations. No FFO, AFFO, EBITDA, NOI or unsupported subtotal is manufactured.

Operating lease income includes specified variable payments; lease-payment-only and all-type lease income are narrower/broader alternatives. Customer-contract revenue uses different accounting scope and tax-inclusive/exclusive alternatives.

Functional cost totals, natural expenses, asset-class impairments and related-party views overlap. Groups explain common overlap; review reasons identify concept-specific scope or presentation issues.
OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes SG&A, unlike OperatingExpenses. CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold excludes financial-service revenue costs and need not equal CostOfRevenue.
Gross investment and interest revenue differ from net investment income, net interest and post-provision net interest. Do not deduct investment costs, interest or credit provisions twice.

Realized/unrealized gains, property/asset classes and sale/impairment/remeasurement events overlap. Event groupings do not define unusual or nonrecurring adjustments or a universal operating/nonoperating location.
Pretax, after-tax, consolidated, parent, redeemable and nonredeemable NCI results preserve distinct scopes. Participating-security allocations are separate from preferred dividends.
Discontinued EPS definitions distinguish activity-only from activity-plus-disposal. Weighted-average issued shares differ from the basic outstanding denominator.
Allowance rollforward movements, oil/gas acquisition capitalization and oil/gas/timber sale concepts remain supplementary; no expense or generic property-sale substitution is inferred.
All concepts are duration facts; all contra flags are false. Source fact signs, dimensions, units and issuer presentation require review even where status is proposed.

metadata_contract.period_type: Verified all 181 concepts as duration in official US GAAP 2026.
metadata_contract.unit_type: Verified 170 monetary, 8 per-share and 3 shares concepts; currency and scale come from source facts.
metadata_contract.contra: False for these earnings, allocation, EPS, share and movement measures; no automatic expense or gain reversal is implied.

taxonomy_reference.note: Metadata and definitions checked against official 2026 schema and documentation. Historical filings retain their own taxonomy versions and units.

sources.description: 181 unique user-supplied US GAAP concepts for SIC 6798.
Official FASB 2026 schema and documentation retained locally.

nodes.label: Revenue presentations
nodes.classification_note: The inventory covers property-owning and mortgage-investment REITs. Gross revenue, rental, customer-contract, investment and noninterest presentations overlap and do not establish a single additive bridge.

children.label: Rental and property management revenue
children.classification_note: Lease income accounting differs from customer contracts. All-type lease income includes operating and financing components; operating lease payments are narrower than operating income including variable payments.

children.label: Operating, direct-financing and sales-type lease income

concepts.name: us-gaap:LeaseIncome
concepts.review_reason: LeaseIncome includes operating, direct-financing and sales-type leases, variable payments and commencement profit; it is not equivalent to rental payments alone.

children.label: Operating lease income including variable payments

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLeaseIncome
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease income includes variable lease payments outside measurement of lease receivables and is narrower than all-type LeaseIncome; avoid adding its lease-payment-only subset.

children.label: Operating lease payment income excluding specified variable payments

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseLeaseIncomeLeasePayments
concepts.review_reason: This lease-payment-only operating income excludes variable lease payments outside the lease-receivable measurement and is included in broader operating lease income.

children.label: Customer-contract revenue alternatives
children.classification_note: Tax-inclusive and tax-exclusive customer revenue are alternative presentation bases. Neither automatically includes lease rental income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Customer-contract revenue excluding assessed tax has a different accounting scope from lease income and differs from the tax-inclusive customer revenue alternative.

children.label: Revenue from contract with customer including assessed tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax
concepts.review_reason: Tax-inclusive customer-contract revenue is an alternative to the tax-exclusive customer revenue amount and does not establish lease revenue equivalence.

children.label: Operating interest and fee revenue
children.classification_note: Combined interest/dividend, loan/lease and security measures overlap. Operating and nonoperating interest use different scopes and premium adjustments.

children.label: Operating interest revenue aggregates
children.classification_note: Operating interest/dividend income may include separate loan, lease, security and interest-only lines.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeOperating
concepts.review_reason: Operating interest-and-dividend income can contain separately reported operating interest, loan fees and security dividends; reconcile the gross revenue population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeOperating
concepts.review_reason: Operating interest income may include loan or security income reported separately; select a reconciled gross operating revenue scope.

children.label: Loan and Lease Interest and Fees

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndDividendIncomeSecurities
concepts.review_reason: Securities interest and dividends can overlap operating interest/dividend and mortgage-security income; match recognition and instrument coverage.

children.label: Loan product interest and fees
children.classification_note: Commercial loans overlap commercial real estate; combined commercial/residential real estate contains commercial real estate. These are product views, not additive categories.

children.label: Commercial loan interest and fee income

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercial
concepts.review_reason: Commercial loan interest/fees can include commercial real estate loan income and be included in all-loans-and-leases income; do not add overlapping product views.

children.label: Commercial and residential real-estate loan interest and fees

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercialAndResidentialRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Commercial-and-residential real-estate loan interest/fees includes the separately supplied commercial-real-estate subset and can overlap other commercial loan groupings.

children.label: Commercial real-estate loan interest and fee income

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndFeeIncomeLoansCommercialRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Commercial-real-estate loan interest/fees are a subset of combined real-estate loan income and may also be included in commercial loan income.

children.label: Mortgage-security and residual interest
children.classification_note: Mortgage-security interest includes premium amortization/accretion; residual interest and dividends require exclusions from broader operating aggregates.

children.label: Operating mortgage-security interest including premium adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeSecuritiesMortgageBacked
concepts.review_reason: Operating mortgage-security interest includes premium/discount amortization and accretion and is a subset of broader security/operating interest income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeOther
concepts.review_reason: Other interest income can be included in broader operating interest, investment interest or interest-and-other income; verify operating classification and residual coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherInterestAndDividendIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other interest/dividend income is a residual that can be included in broader combined operating or investment income aggregates.

children.label: Other and noninterest revenue views
children.classification_note: Noninterest aggregates can include lease income and management fees; residual operating income differs from unspecified other income and net other operating results.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoninterestIncome
concepts.review_reason: Noninterest revenue can contain rental, management and investment gain components; it is a mortgage/financial-service presentation aggregate, not additional revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoninterestIncomeOtherOperatingIncome
concepts.review_reason: Noninterest other operating income can be a subset of NoninterestIncome and overlap OtherOperatingIncome; establish issuer residual coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other operating income can be included in noninterest other operating income or broader residual net operating results; identify exclusions.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: OtherIncome has no explicit operating restriction and may contain property management, investment or ancillary gains; determine the issuer location and residual exclusions.

nodes.label: Operating costs and expenses
nodes.classification_note: Functional expense totals, natural costs and property-specific charges overlap. Expense signs are source-dependent; no automatic sum or sign reversal is prescribed.

children.label: Reported expense total alternatives
children.classification_note: OperatingExpenses includes SG&A; OperatingCostsAndExpenses excludes SG&A; CostsAndExpenses combines cost of sales and operating costs; NoninterestExpense excludes interest. Select the issuer presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: CostsAndExpenses combines cost of sales and operating expenses and may contain property costs, depreciation and other identified charges already mapped separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OperatingExpenses includes SG&A, whereas OperatingCostsAndExpenses explicitly excludes SG&A; the totals are not interchangeable or additive.

children.label: Operating costs excluding SG&A and cost of sales

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingCostsAndExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OperatingCostsAndExpenses explicitly excludes SG&A, unlike OperatingExpenses; reconcile property, depreciation and cost-of-revenue inclusion before use.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoninterestExpense
concepts.review_reason: Noninterest expense can include property, administrative and impairment costs but excludes interest; reconcile its scope with operating and all-cost totals.

children.label: Cost of revenue alternatives
children.classification_note: CostOfRevenue and goods/services cost can differ in scope; the latter excludes financial-service costs. Both may include property costs and depreciation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfRevenue
concepts.review_reason: CostOfRevenue can differ from the goods/services-cost tag and can already include depreciation and direct property operating costs.

children.label: Cost of Goods and Services Sold

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold
concepts.review_reason: Cost of goods/services sold excludes financial-service revenue costs under its definition and may differ from the broader CostOfRevenue presentation for mixed REIT activities.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherCostOfOperatingRevenue
concepts.review_reason: Other costs of operating revenue can be included in cost of revenue or residual property costs; reconcile functional exclusions.

children.label: Property operating costs
children.classification_note: Direct lessor property cost can already include repairs, taxes/insurance and residual property costs. Lessee lease expenses represent another role.

children.label: Direct property costs
children.classification_note: Combined and residual property cost views overlap natural expenses. Repairs maintain condition rather than capitalize improvements.

children.label: Direct lessor property and equipment costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:DirectCostsOfLeasedAndRentedPropertyOrEquipment
concepts.review_reason: Direct lessor operating-lease costs can include repairs, property tax and other property expenses reported separately; reconcile inclusions before selecting details.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfOtherPropertyOperatingExpense
concepts.review_reason: Residual property operating costs can include maintenance and be contained in direct lessor property costs; confirm exclusions from separately selected property expenses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostOfPropertyRepairsAndMaintenance
concepts.review_reason: Repairs/maintenance are noncapital property upkeep and can be included in direct or other property operating costs; distinguish capital improvements.

children.label: Property taxes and insurance
children.classification_note: Real-estate tax expense is included in taxes-plus-insurance for the same property population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateTaxesAndInsurance
concepts.review_reason: Combined real-estate taxes and insurance include separately mapped property tax expense and may be included in direct property operating costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealEstateTaxExpense
concepts.review_reason: Property tax expense is included in real-estate taxes plus insurance where both refer to the same properties and may already be included in direct property costs.

children.label: Lessee operating lease expenses
children.classification_note: Single lease cost and operating lease expense are overlapping lessee measures, distinct from lessor rental revenue and direct property operating costs.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseCost
concepts.review_reason: The single operating lease cost is a lessee charge and may already be included in OperatingLeaseExpense or functional property expenses; it is not a reduction of lessor rental revenue by definition.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OperatingLeaseExpense
concepts.review_reason: Operating lease expense excludes sublease income and can overlap single operating lease cost and property expense; identify lessee role and included functional charges.

children.label: Depreciation, amortization and accretion
children.classification_note: Nonproduction depreciation is included in nonproduction D&A. Net D&A/accretion is broader and can include financing/investment adjustments or cash-flow reconciliation amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAndAmortization
concepts.review_reason: This depreciation/amortization tag describes nonproduction asset charges and can already be included in cost of revenue or property expenses; reconcile functional scope before separate addition.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationNonproduction
concepts.review_reason: Nonproduction depreciation is a subset of the supplied nonproduction depreciation-and-amortization measure and can be included in property expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DepreciationAmortizationAndAccretionNet
concepts.review_reason: Net depreciation/amortization/accretion is broader than nonproduction D&A and can contain investment premium/discount effects; establish components before using it as an IS expense.

children.label: Administrative and management expenses
children.classification_note: SG&A, G&A and natural management/personnel/professional costs can overlap. Counterparty-related costs remain separate disclosure views.

children.label: Administrative totals and residuals
children.classification_note: G&A is narrower than SG&A, and other G&A is a residual. OtherGeneralExpense has a distinct definition and is not presumed equivalent to other G&A.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: SG&A includes G&A and selling functions and can contain management, labor and professional costs; do not add its G&A subset or natural expenses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Residual G&A is included in broader G&A and SG&A totals and can overlap other general expense depending on issuer presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherGeneralExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other general expense is defined outside usual other operating cost/expense categories; establish issuer functional location rather than substituting OtherGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense.

children.label: Manager fee expenses
children.classification_note: Investment management and performance-based incentive fees can be embedded in G&A or related-party expense totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ManagementFeeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Investment management fee expense can be included in G&A, related-party or mortgage-investment expense totals and may include separately reported incentive fees.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncentiveFeeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Performance-based incentive fee expense can be included in management fees or G&A and may involve an affiliate manager; reconcile the reported arrangement.

children.label: Personnel and equity awards
children.classification_note: Labor includes equity compensation; option expense and accelerated incremental award cost can already be included in labor, SG&A or event charges.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LaborAndRelatedExpense
concepts.review_reason: Labor costs include salary, benefits and equity compensation and can be included in G&A or property cost totals; option and accelerated award costs may already be included.

concepts.name: us-gaap:StockOptionPlanExpense
concepts.review_reason: Noncash stock-option expense can already be included in labor, SG&A or accelerated share-award cost; reconcile the specific award population.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ShareBasedCompensationArrangementByShareBasedPaymentAwardAcceleratedCompensationCost
concepts.review_reason: Accelerated share-award cost is an incremental compensation charge and can be included in labor, restructuring or integration expense; do not add it again to those totals.

children.label: Professional and legal costs
children.classification_note: Legal costs can be part of professional services, G&A, litigation or acquisition charges; no additive functional bridge is inferred.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfessionalFees
concepts.review_reason: Professional fees may be included in G&A, acquisition costs or restructuring and can overlap separately mapped legal fees.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LegalFees
concepts.review_reason: Legal fees can be included in professional fees, G&A, acquisition or litigation expense; identify residual exclusions before separate addition.

children.label: Impairment and credit expenses
children.classification_note: Broad impairment and portfolio/asset-specific charges overlap. Credit allowance rollforward changes are supplementary, not provision expense.

children.label: Broad impairment measures
children.classification_note: All assets includes tangible, intangible and goodwill. Other long-lived asset impairment excludes goodwill but can overlap tangible and intangible asset measures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: All-asset impairment includes tangible assets, intangible assets and goodwill and overlaps the narrower impairment charges retained separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:TangibleAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Tangible impairment can include investment real estate and other long-lived assets and is contained in broad all-asset impairment.

children.label: Other long-lived asset impairment excluding goodwill

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: Other long-lived impairment excludes goodwill but can overlap tangible and intangible impairments and the broad asset impairment total.

children.label: Property and long-lived impairment
children.classification_note: Real-estate, held-for-use and disposal impairments classify by different overlapping axes. Non-sale disposals can be in held-for-use impairment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Real-estate impairment can be included in tangible/long-lived asset impairment and the combined asset-sale/impairment result; select a matched property population.

children.label: Impairment of long-lived assets held for use

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsHeldForUse
concepts.review_reason: Held-and-used long-lived impairments include non-sale disposals and can overlap real-estate, tangible and other long-lived asset impairment disclosures.

children.label: Impairment of long-lived assets to be disposed of

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfLongLivedAssetsToBeDisposedOf
concepts.review_reason: Long-lived disposal impairments include abandonment, exchange and sale and can overlap held-for-use impairments for non-sale disposals; reconcile intended disposition.

children.label: Goodwill, intangibles and investee impairment
children.classification_note: Goodwill and goodwill-excluding intangibles can be contained in all-asset impairment. Equity-method impairment differs from proportionate investee operating results.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GoodwillImpairmentLoss
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill impairment is included in all-asset impairment and must not be added again when that aggregate is selected.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ImpairmentOfIntangibleAssetsExcludingGoodwill
concepts.review_reason: Goodwill-excluding intangible impairment is a subset of broad asset impairment and may contain acquired lease intangible impairment already classified as real-estate related.

concepts.name: us-gaap:EquityMethodInvestmentOtherThanTemporaryImpairment
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method other-than-temporary impairment can already affect the reported investee carrying/result presentation; distinguish it from the REIT share of investee operating income.

children.label: Credit loss expense and reversals
children.classification_note: General financing expense can overlap the interest-excluding financing expense; other-credit exposures require a portfolio exclusion. None equals a total allowance balance change.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForLoanLossesExpensed
concepts.review_reason: Financing-receivable credit loss expense may overlap the interest-excluding credit-loss expense and broader impairment charges; preserve reversal signs and portfolio scope.

children.label: Financing Receivable Credit Loss Expense (Reversal), Excluding Interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestCreditLossExpenseReversal
concepts.review_reason: This financing credit expense excludes accrued interest and net lease investments and can overlap the broader financing-receivable provision; use a matched portfolio.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProvisionForOtherCreditLosses
concepts.review_reason: Other-credit loss provision covers exposures outside selected loan classifications and may be included in broader impairment expense; establish portfolio exclusions.

children.label: Other operating cost views
children.classification_note: Operating and unspecified residual costs can overlap broader expense totals; other net operating results are classified separately.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherCostAndExpenseOperating
concepts.review_reason: Other operating cost/expense can include residual property, acquisition or administrative costs; match exclusions to other separately selected expense lines.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherExpenses
concepts.review_reason: OtherExpenses does not specify operating classification and may overlap other operating or nonoperating residual amounts; establish issuer placement.

children.label: Related-party expense views
children.classification_note: Related-party and affiliate costs classify by counterparty rather than expense function and can be included in property, manager or G&A totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:CostsAndExpensesRelatedParty
concepts.review_reason: Related-party expenses classify by counterparty and can contain property, management or G&A costs already mapped by function.

concepts.name: us-gaap:AffiliateCosts
concepts.review_reason: Affiliate costs are counterparty-based expenses associated with affiliate revenues and can overlap related-party, management or property cost lines.

nodes.label: Operating result measures
nodes.classification_note: GrossProfit is a revenue-minus-cost-of-revenue subtotal, while OperatingIncomeLoss deducts operating expenses; issuer definitions and included costs must match. Net other operating results can already be included; net cost of other-real-estate operations is a separate limited-scope result.

children.label: Other operating income or expense, net

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherOperatingIncomeExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: Other operating income/expense is a net residual that overlaps separate other operating income and expense views; do not treat it as additional gross revenue.

children.label: Net cost of other real estate operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:ProfitLossFromRealEstateOperations
concepts.review_reason: The official definition is net cost of other-real-estate operations including losses, rental income and sale gains; it is not a general REIT operating-profit or NOI subtotal.

nodes.label: Interest, investments and equity-method results
nodes.classification_note: Interest classification and instrument scopes overlap. Gross, net-of-investment-cost and net-interest measures require issuer-specific reconciliation.

children.label: Interest expense presentations
children.classification_note: Total interest includes operating and nonoperating interest. Instrument/maturity detail and interest-plus-debt cost measures overlap; excluding amortization changes the measurement.

children.label: Reported interest scopes
children.classification_note: Total, operating and nonoperating interest are overlapping classification levels. Interest/debt expense includes nonoperating debt-related costs beyond pure interest.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseOperating
concepts.review_reason: Operating interest is included in total interest and can be part of gross-to-net mortgage investment presentation; do not deduct it again from net interest income.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseNonoperating
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating interest is contained in total operating/nonoperating interest and can overlap debt-interest instrument disclosures.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndDebtExpense
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating interest-and-debt expense includes debt-related costs beyond pure interest and can overlap total/nonoperating interest and issuance-cost amortization.

children.label: Debt interest details
children.classification_note: Debt interest, long-term interest, repo interest and residual interest can cover the same instruments. Debt interest excluding amortization is a narrower expense measure.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebt
concepts.review_reason: Debt interest is an instrument-based scope that can cross operating and nonoperating classifications and overlap total interest or interest-and-debt expense.

children.label: Debt interest excluding premium and issuance-cost amortization

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseDebtExcludingAmortization
concepts.review_reason: Debt interest excluding amortization is narrower than debt interest including discount/premium/finance-cost amortization; do not use it as an interchangeable total.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseLongTermDebt
concepts.review_reason: Long-term debt interest is a maturity subset of debt and total interest and can include separately mapped repo or other borrowing costs depending on issuer scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RepurchaseAgreementsInterestExpenseAmount
concepts.review_reason: Repo interest is an instrument-specific borrowing cost and may be included in total interest, debt expense or other interest expense.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestExpenseOther
concepts.review_reason: Other interest expense may already be contained in debt or total interest expense and depends on issuer residual instrument exclusions.

children.label: Net interest presentations
children.classification_note: Net interest, nonoperating net interest and post-loan-provision net interest differ in included costs and activity scope. Do not deduct separately supplied interest or provisions twice.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNet
concepts.review_reason: Net interest income is not gross interest revenue and can overlap separately supplied interest income and expense; do not deduct interest expense twice.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseNonoperatingNet
concepts.review_reason: Net nonoperating interest is a different classification scope from gross operating interest and all net-interest income; avoid deducting its included expense again.

children.label: Net Interest Income After Loan Loss Provision

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestIncomeExpenseAfterProvisionForLoanLoss
concepts.review_reason: This net interest result is after loan-loss provision and overlaps both net interest income and credit expense; do not deduct those costs again.

children.label: Investment income and costs
children.classification_note: Net investment income can already deduct investment expenses; interest/dividend combined amounts overlap individual components and security income reported in operating revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeNet
concepts.review_reason: Net investment income already deducts investment expenses and can overlap interest/dividend components; do not deduct the separate investment expense again.

children.label: Nonoperating investment interest and dividend income

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterestAndDividend
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating interest-and-dividend investment income overlaps separately supplied interest and dividends and may differ from the net investment income scope.

children.label: Nonoperating securities interest before premium adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInterest
concepts.review_reason: Nonoperating securities interest here is before premium/discount amortization or accretion; it is not equivalent to operating mortgage-security interest including those adjustments.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeDividend
concepts.review_reason: Investment dividend income can be included in combined interest/dividend or net investment income; reconcile the same investment portfolio.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InvestmentIncomeInvestmentExpense
concepts.review_reason: Investment expense can already be deducted in InvestmentIncomeNet and may overlap management fees; it is not an extra deduction from a selected net investment result.

concepts.name: us-gaap:InterestAndOtherIncome
concepts.review_reason: Interest and other ancillary income can include separate interest and other nonoperating income lines; it is not equivalent to a pure investment-interest amount.

children.label: Equity-method earnings
children.classification_note: Issuer presentation determines the relation to operating/pretax subtotals; investee earnings differ from dividends and investment disposal/impairment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Equity-method results may be presented before or after a reported operating/pretax subtotal; the two supplied pretax totals differ in whether these results are included.

children.label: Other nonoperating result views
children.classification_note: Nonoperating aggregate and residual net amounts contain narrower income-only, expense-only and gains/losses views. These are not independent additive totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:NonoperatingIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: The nonoperating aggregate can include interest, equity-method and other results separately mapped; confirm issuer inclusions before using details alongside it.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncomeExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating income/expense is a residual that may already contain separately mapped nonoperating income, expense and gains/losses.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingIncome
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating income is the income-only view and can be included in the supplied net other nonoperating result.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingExpense
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating expense is an expense-only view that can be included in the net other nonoperating result.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherNonoperatingGainsLosses
concepts.review_reason: Other nonoperating gains/losses can be contained in the supplied net other nonoperating income/expense; they are not an additional aggregate.

nodes.label: Disposal, investment and event results
nodes.classification_note: These earnings families are not an unusual-items total. Operating/nonoperating placement depends on issuer reporting; asset scopes, realization and event types overlap.

children.label: Property and asset disposal results
children.classification_note: Investment real estate, PP&E and broad assets are different overlapping populations. Sale gains are earnings amounts, not cash proceeds.

children.label: Investment and other real estate results
children.classification_note: Investment sale gains overlap generic property gains. Other-real-estate result also includes foreclosure valuation changes, not just sale events.

children.label: Investment real estate sale and disposal gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfInvestmentRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Investment-real-estate sale/disposal results can overlap the broader property-sale and asset-disposal tags; identify the same property and event once.

children.label: Real estate and property sale gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperties
concepts.review_reason: This real-estate/property sale gain is an earnings amount rather than sale proceeds and can overlap investment-real-estate sales and generic disposal results.

children.label: Other real estate sale and valuation result

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfOtherRealEstate
concepts.review_reason: Other-real-estate result includes foreclosure valuation allowance changes and write-downs as well as sales, so it is not a sale-only investment-property gain.

children.label: PP&E and broader asset disposals
children.classification_note: PP&E disposal excluding oil/gas/timber is narrower than inclusive PP&E sale gains. Broad assets include intangibles and investment interests; financial-service asset disposals have a business-scope restriction.

children.label: PP&E sale gain or loss including oil, gas and timber

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfPropertyPlantEquipment
concepts.review_reason: PP&E sale/disposal gains include oil/gas and timber property, unlike the narrower PP&E disposition concept; reconcile issuer asset scope before substitution.

children.label: PP&E disposal gain or loss excluding oil, gas and timber

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets
concepts.review_reason: This PP&E disposal result excludes oil/gas and timber property; it overlaps part of the broader asset-disposal and inclusive PP&E-sale results.

children.label: Broad asset disposal gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDispositionOfAssets1
concepts.review_reason: This broad disposal gain includes PP&E, intangibles and subsidiary/equity-method securities, unlike the similarly named narrower PP&E disposal tag.

children.label: Financial-service asset disposal gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainsLossesOnSalesOfAssets
concepts.review_reason: The official definition covers disposal gains on assets used in financial-service operations, rather than all REIT property sales; retain its business scope.

children.label: Other asset disposal gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherAssets
concepts.review_reason: Other-asset disposal gains require exclusions for properties, businesses and securities separately mapped; they can be included in broad asset-sale results.

children.label: Combined disposal and impairment result
children.classification_note: The combined result overlaps both separate asset sale gains and impairment charges; select a reconciled aggregate or components.

children.label: Combined asset sale and impairment result

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfAssetsAndAssetImpairmentCharges
concepts.review_reason: This combined sale/disposal-and-impairment result contains both earnings event types and cannot be added to its separate disposal and impairment components.

children.label: Investment security and loan results
children.classification_note: Realized/unrealized status and instrument class overlap. Combined totals must not be added to their realized-only or portfolio-specific components.

children.label: Aggregate investment gain scopes
children.classification_note: Combined investment gain includes realized and unrealized results; broad realized and unrealized-only views are not extra categories.

children.label: Realized and unrealized investment gains and losses

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Investment gain/loss combines realized and unrealized amounts and overlaps realized-only, unrealized-only and marketable-security results.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RealizedInvestmentGainsLosses
concepts.review_reason: Realized investment gains are included in combined investment gains and can contain specific loan or security sale results.

concepts.name: us-gaap:UnrealizedGainLossOnInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Unrealized investment gains are included in realized-plus-unrealized investment totals and can contain mortgage security fair-value changes; exclude OCI-only changes from earnings presentation.

children.label: Marketable-security gain scopes
children.classification_note: Combined and realized-only marketable results overlap generic investment gains and narrower MBS sale results; names do not establish a disjoint portfolio.

children.label: Realized and unrealized marketable-security gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesGainLossExcludingOtherThanTemporaryImpairments
concepts.review_reason: Marketable-security realized-and-unrealized gains overlap generic investment and realized-only marketable results; retain exclusions and issuer taxonomy-version context.

concepts.name: us-gaap:MarketableSecuritiesRealizedGainLossExcludingOtherThanTemporaryImpairments
concepts.review_reason: Realized-only marketable-security results are a subset of combined marketable gains and can include separately mapped MBS or other investment sale results.

children.label: Loan, MBS and other-investment disposal results
children.classification_note: Loan/MBS sale gains and residual investment disposals may be included in broad realized gains. They differ from interest and cash consideration.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfLoansNet
concepts.review_reason: Net loan sale gains may be included in realized investment or mortgage operating income; they are not loan sale proceeds or interest revenue.

children.label: Mortgage-backed security sale gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSalesOfMortgageBackedSecuritiesMBS
concepts.review_reason: MBS sale gains can be included in realized investment/marketable-security results and do not include interest or unrealized valuation gains.

children.label: Other investment disposal gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfOtherInvestments
concepts.review_reason: Other-investment disposal results may be included in broader realized investment gains; establish the residual asset population.

children.label: Derivative earnings results
children.classification_note: Pretax aggregate, earnings fair-value, realized sale, nonhedging and interest-rate nonhedging amounts overlap by event and instrument scope.

children.label: Derivative aggregate and measurement views
children.classification_note: All-derivative pretax results may contain fair-value and sale measures. Earnings fair-value changes are not the derivative carrying balance.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnDerivativeInstrumentsNetPretax
concepts.review_reason: All-derivative pretax earnings include narrower nonhedging, interest-rate, fair-value and sale-result disclosures; reconcile scope before combining.

children.label: Derivative fair-value change recognized in earnings

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeGainLossOnDerivativeNet
concepts.review_reason: The earnings fair-value change on derivatives can be included in pretax all-derivative or nonhedging derivative results; establish the instrument and realization coverage.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfDerivatives
concepts.review_reason: Derivative sale gains are a realized event subset and may be included in all-derivative or nonhedging realized-and-unrealized results.

children.label: Nonhedging derivative views
children.classification_note: Nonhedging realized/unrealized gains contain interest-rate nonhedging results; do not add the subset to its aggregate.

children.label: Nonhedging derivative realized and unrealized gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:DerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstrumentsGainLossNet
concepts.review_reason: Nonhedging derivative gains include realized and unrealized results and can contain the narrower interest-rate derivative result and sale gains.

children.label: Nonhedging interest-rate derivative gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnInterestRateDerivativeInstrumentsNotDesignatedAsHedgingInstruments
concepts.review_reason: Nonhedging interest-rate derivative earnings are a subset of all nonhedging derivative results and may be included in the all-derivative pretax result.

children.label: Acquisition and control-change results
children.classification_note: Transaction costs, integration costs, prior-interest remeasurement, deconsolidation and nonbusiness VIE initial consolidation are distinct event types. Each can overlap other expenses or gains.

children.label: Acquisition and integration costs
children.classification_note: Integration excludes acquisition transaction costs but can include restructuring, severance and other post-combination charges; reconcile costs by event.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationAcquisitionRelatedCosts
concepts.review_reason: Business combination acquisition expense excludes capitalized asset acquisition costs and can contain professional, legal and G&A charges separately disclosed elsewhere.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationIntegrationRelatedCosts
concepts.review_reason: Business integration costs exclude acquisition transaction expense but can include severance/restructuring and other post-combination costs separately supplied.

children.label: Step-acquisition remeasurement
children.classification_note: Gain-only and gain-or-loss prior-interest remeasurement are alternative scopes for business combinations achieved in stages.

children.label: Step-acquisition prior-interest remeasurement gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationStepAcquisitionEquityInterestInAcquireeRemeasurementGainOrLoss
concepts.review_reason: Step-acquisition gain/loss remeasurement includes the separate gain-only tag and differs from initial consolidation of a nonbusiness VIE.

concepts.name: us-gaap:BusinessCombinationStepAcquisitionEquityInterestInAcquireeRemeasurementGain
concepts.review_reason: The gain-only step-acquisition remeasurement overlaps the supplied gain-or-loss concept and must not be added to it or used to represent losses.

children.label: Business disposal and control changes
children.classification_note: Business sale, continuing-operation disposal group and deconsolidation can overlap the same event. Initial nonbusiness VIE consolidation is a separate recognition event.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfBusiness
concepts.review_reason: Business disposal gains can overlap broad asset disposition/deconsolidation results; determine control, discontinued status and event scope.

children.label: Gain or loss on disposal within continuing operations

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupNotDiscontinuedOperationGainLossOnDisposal
concepts.review_reason: This pretax disposal-group result excludes discontinued operations and can overlap business/asset disposal gains; establish issuer operating or nonoperating presentation.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DeconsolidationGainOrLossAmount
concepts.review_reason: Deconsolidation gains depend on loss of control and differ from sales of interests while retaining control; reconcile inclusion in business or asset disposal results.

children.label: Initial consolidation gain or loss for a nonbusiness VIE

concepts.name: us-gaap:VariableInterestEntityInitialConsolidationGainOrLoss
concepts.review_reason: Initial consolidation gain/loss applies to a VIE that is not a business and is distinct from step-acquisition remeasurement in a business combination.

children.label: Restructuring, litigation, recoveries and other events
children.classification_note: These costs/recoveries can be included in operating or nonoperating totals. No unusual-item subtotal or universal sign treatment is created.

children.label: Restructuring and severance
children.classification_note: Contractual/special termination benefits can be contained in restructuring or integration costs; the supplied severance tag excludes one-time termination benefits.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RestructuringCharges
concepts.review_reason: Restructuring costs can include severance or integration components but exclude discontinued operations and asset retirement obligations; reconcile event and expense scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:SeveranceCosts1
concepts.review_reason: This severance tag covers special/contractual termination benefits under an exit/disposal plan and excludes one-time benefits; it may overlap restructuring or integration costs.

children.label: Litigation and contingencies
children.classification_note: Net settlement results can overlap litigation expense and contingency losses; identify the same event and professional fees before using separate charges.

children.label: Litigation and insurance settlement gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossRelatedToLitigationSettlement
concepts.review_reason: Litigation/insurance settlement gains or losses can overlap insurance recoveries and settlement expense; establish gross-versus-net and event scope.

concepts.name: us-gaap:LitigationSettlementExpense
concepts.review_reason: Litigation expense can include legal and investigative fees and may overlap separately reported legal/professional costs or net settlement results.

children.label: Contingency loss or reversal recognized in the period

concepts.name: us-gaap:LossContingencyLossInPeriod
concepts.review_reason: Contingency loss/reversal can be included in litigation, settlement or other expense; identify the same event and keep unrelated contingencies distinct.

children.label: Insurance recoveries
children.classification_note: General insurance recoveries reduce costs/losses, whereas business-interruption gains include lost earnings and amounts above incremental costs; their presentation can overlap.

children.label: Insurance recoveries reducing operating costs or losses

concepts.name: us-gaap:InsuranceRecoveries
concepts.review_reason: Insurance recoveries reduce reported costs/losses and can overlap settlement gains or business-interruption recovery gains; they are not automatically gross rental revenue.

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainOnBusinessInterruptionInsuranceRecovery
concepts.review_reason: Business interruption recovery gains include lost earnings and amounts above incremental costs; reconcile inclusion in broader insurance recoveries and settlement results.

children.label: Debt extinguishment and currency results
children.classification_note: Debt extinguishment gains differ from borrowing cash flows; foreign-currency transaction earnings differ from currency translation OCI.

concepts.name: us-gaap:ForeignCurrencyTransactionGainLossBeforeTax
concepts.review_reason: Pretax foreign-currency transaction results are earnings items and can be included in other income/expense; they are not currency-translation OCI.

nodes.label: Pretax income and tax
nodes.classification_note: Pretax subtotals differ in equity-method inclusion. Current tax is included in continuing-operation current-plus-deferred tax; discontinued tax is separate.

children.label: Pretax income alternatives
children.classification_note: The before-equity-method measure is narrower than pretax income including investee results; both precede tax and noncontrolling attribution.

children.label: Pretax continuing income before noncontrolling interests
Pretax continuing income before equity-method results
Continuing-operation tax
children.classification_note: Current tax excludes deferred expense and is contained in total continuing-operation tax; no absent deferred amount is manufactured.

children.label: Continuing-operation income tax expense or benefit
Current income tax expense or benefit

nodes.label: Continuing and discontinued results
nodes.classification_note: Consolidated and parent-attributable results have different NCI scope. Discontinued activity income and disposal gains can be components of after-tax discontinued totals.

children.label: Continuing-operation income attribution
children.classification_note: Consolidated continuing income includes NCI; the parent amount excludes it. Do not deduct NCI again from a parent-attributable measure.

children.label: Discontinued-operation income attribution
children.classification_note: Consolidated and parent after-tax totals overlap; pretax result, tax, activity income and disposal result require a matched attribution scope.

children.label: Discontinued-operation income tax expense or benefit
After-tax discontinued-operation activity income excluding disposal
After-tax discontinued-operation disposal gain or loss

nodes.label: Net income and noncontrolling attribution
nodes.classification_note: Consolidated profit includes NCI; parent NetIncomeLoss excludes it. NCI entity type, redeemability and tax basis are overlapping disclosure axes.

children.label: NCI total and tax-basis views
children.classification_note: The net NCI amount is after tax; the similarly named IncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest is before tax and is not interchangeable.

children.label: Net income attributable to noncontrolling interests
NCI income or loss before tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:IncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: This NCI income measure is before tax, unlike NetIncomeLossAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest and the supplied after-tax partnership components.

children.label: NCI ownership components
children.classification_note: Nonredeemable NCI contains operating-partnership/joint-venture views that may overlap. Redeemable partnership NCI has a different equity classification.

children.label: Nonredeemable NCI net income, after tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:NetIncomeLossAttributableToNonredeemableNoncontrollingInterest
concepts.review_reason: Nonredeemable after-tax NCI income is a subset of all NCI income and can contain operating-partnership and joint-venture components.

children.label: Redeemable operating-partnership NCI income, after tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOperatingPartnershipsRedeemable
concepts.review_reason: Redeemable operating-partnership after-tax NCI income is an ownership subset distinct from nonredeemable NCI and may be included in all NCI income.

children.label: Nonredeemable operating-partnership NCI income, after tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossOperatingPartnershipsNonredeemable
concepts.review_reason: Nonredeemable operating-partnership after-tax NCI income is contained in broader nonredeemable and total NCI scopes.

children.label: Nonredeemable joint-venture NCI income, after tax

concepts.name: us-gaap:NoncontrollingInterestInNetIncomeLossJointVenturePartnersNonredeemable
concepts.review_reason: Nonredeemable joint-venture NCI after-tax income is a subset of nonredeemable/all NCI and may overlap partnership NCI where the same investee is a partnership.

nodes.label: Common income and allocations
nodes.classification_note: Preferred adjustments and participating-security allocations are distinct. Basic/diluted common numerators differ and may already reflect supplied adjustments.

children.label: Preferred dividends and redemption adjustments
children.classification_note: The preferred adjustment aggregate can contain ordinary/other dividends, redemption premiums and discount accretion; select reconciled components without double deduction.

children.label: Preferred dividends and other common-income adjustments

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockDividendsAndOtherAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Preferred dividends and other adjustments can include redemption premium, discount accretion and participating-security effects; reconcile rather than deducting separate adjustments again.

concepts.name: us-gaap:RedeemablePreferredStockDividends
concepts.review_reason: This tag describes dividends paid on preferred stock redeemable solely at issuer option; determine whether used as a common-income adjustment and avoid duplicating preferred dividend amounts.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockRedemptionPremium
concepts.review_reason: Preferred redemption premium can be included in preferred-dividend-and-other adjustments but is not an ordinary preferred dividend; reconcile the common-income numerator treatment.

concepts.name: us-gaap:PreferredStockAccretionOfRedemptionDiscount
concepts.review_reason: Preferred redemption discount accretion can affect common-income attribution without being an ordinary dividend; reconcile inclusion in preferred-adjustment totals.

concepts.name: us-gaap:OtherPreferredStockDividendsAndAdjustments
concepts.review_reason: Other preferred dividends/adjustments are a residual within broader preferred adjustments and may contain redemption-related items separately supplied.

children.label: Participating-security allocations
children.classification_note: Basic distributed-plus-undistributed earnings include the basic undistributed portion; diluted undistributed allocations use a different EPS numerator basis.

children.label: Basic distributed and undistributed participating-security earnings

concepts.name: us-gaap:ParticipatingSecuritiesDistributedAndUndistributedEarningsLossBasic
concepts.review_reason: Basic distributed-plus-undistributed participating-security allocations already include the separately supplied basic undistributed portion; no preferred-dividend classification is implied.

children.label: Basic undistributed earnings allocated to participating securities

concepts.name: us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesBasic
concepts.review_reason: Basic undistributed earnings allocated to participating securities are included in the broader distributed-plus-undistributed allocation; this is not a preferred dividend.

children.label: Diluted undistributed earnings allocated to participating securities

concepts.name: us-gaap:UndistributedEarningsLossAllocatedToParticipatingSecuritiesDiluted
concepts.review_reason: Diluted undistributed participating-security allocations use diluted numerator assumptions and are not interchangeable with basic allocations.

children.label: Income available to common shareholders - basic
Income available to common shareholders - diluted

nodes.label: Earnings per share
nodes.classification_note: Basic/diluted and total/continuing/discontinued scopes are distinct. Do not add per-share measures without a matched numerator, denominator and result scope.

children.label: Total earnings per share
children.classification_note: Basic and diluted EPS use different denominator assumptions and are not additive.

children.label: Continuing-operation earnings per share
children.classification_note: Continuing EPS is a result subset of total EPS; retain basic/diluted distinctions.

children.label: Discontinued EPS including disposal
children.classification_note: These two taxonomy definitions include day-to-day discontinued activity and the disposal gain/loss.

children.label: Basic discontinued-operation EPS including disposal result
Diluted discontinued-operation EPS including disposal result
Discontinued activity EPS excluding disposal
children.classification_note: Despite similar names, these definitions cover day-to-day activity only, unlike the broader discontinued EPS concepts.

children.label: Basic discontinued-operation activity EPS excluding disposal
Diluted discontinued-operation activity EPS excluding disposal

nodes.label: Weighted-average outstanding shares
nodes.classification_note: These duration counts are EPS denominators and differ from instant shares and weighted-average issued shares before treasury reductions.

nodes.label: Supplementary disclosures
nodes.classification_note: Geographic and disposal-group subsets, allowance movements, issued-share counts and taxonomy concepts outside ordinary REIT scope remain separate from primary earnings categories.

children.label: Geographic and disposal-group results
children.classification_note: Domestic pretax income is a geographic subset. Disposal-group operating income can include groups not classified as discontinued; neither is an extra consolidated result.

concepts.name: us-gaap:DisposalGroupIncludingDiscontinuedOperationOperatingIncomeLoss
concepts.review_reason: Disposal-group operating income can include groups not qualifying as discontinued operations and is not equivalent to after-tax discontinued-operation income.

children.label: Credit allowance movements
children.classification_note: Changes in credit allowance balances can include write-offs, recoveries and other adjustments beyond IS expense; no provision is inferred from these rollforwards.

children.label: Change in trade receivable credit allowance

concepts.name: us-gaap:AllowanceForDoubtfulAccountsReceivablePeriodIncreaseDecrease
concepts.review_reason: The trade credit allowance period movement can include write-offs, recoveries and other changes beyond credit-loss expense; do not treat the balance rollforward as IS provision.

children.label: Change in financing credit allowance excluding accrued interest

concepts.name: us-gaap:FinancingReceivableExcludingAccruedInterestAllowanceForCreditLossPeriodIncreaseDecrease
concepts.review_reason: The interest-excluding financing allowance change excludes lease investments and includes movements beyond provision expense; retain as a credit allowance rollforward disclosure.

children.label: Weighted-average issued shares
children.classification_note: Issued shares precede treasury and other reductions and are not an automatic replacement for the basic outstanding-share denominator.

children.label: Weighted-average shares issued before treasury reductions

concepts.name: us-gaap:WeightedAverageNumberOfSharesIssuedBasic
concepts.review_reason: Weighted-average issued shares are before reductions such as treasury shares and do not automatically equal weighted-average outstanding shares used as the basic EPS denominator.

children.label: Oil, gas and timber scope candidates
children.classification_note: Official definitions restrict these tags to capitalized full-cost oil/gas acquisitions or oil/gas/timber disposal earnings. Retain for issuer review, not generic REIT acquisition/property-sale mapping.

children.label: Capitalized full-cost oil and gas acquisition costs

concepts.name: us-gaap:AcquisitionCosts
concepts.review_reason: The official definition is capitalized full-cost oil/gas acquisition cost excluded from amortization; this is not a REIT business-combination expense and requires issuer/taxonomy-use review.

children.label: Oil, gas or timber property sale gain or loss

concepts.name: us-gaap:GainLossOnSaleOfProperty
concepts.review_reason: The official definition restricts this property-sale tag to oil/gas or timber property; do not map it as general investment-real-estate sale gains without issuer/taxonomy-use review.
